summary: SFTPStorageBackend, registered for CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE.SFTP, operates on a paramiko SFTPClient borrowed from an SFTPConnection. It implements StorageReadProtocol (SFTPReadMixin), StorageWriteProtocol (SFTPWriteMixin), StorageEnumerateProtocol (SFTPEnumerateMixin), StorageDeleteProtocol (SFTPDeleteMixin), StorageMetadataProtocol (SFTPMetadataMixin), StorageDirectoryProtocol (SFTPDirectoryMixin) and, via SFTPReadMixin.open_ranged, RangedReadProtocol; it does not implement StorageCopyProtocol. sftp:// URLs are converted to remote paths only when host and port match the connected profile, otherwise LocationNotAllowed is raised.
key_classes: SFTPStorageBackend — registered SFTP backend; _get_client() returns the connection's SFTPClient or raises StorageConnectionError
SFTPReadMixin — StorageReadProtocol: read_to_bytes, forward-only read_to_stream without prefetch, plus open_ranged (seek/read on a native handle, no version pinning)
SFTPWriteMixin — StorageWriteProtocol: writes via sftp.open('wb'), creating parents through SFTPDirectoryMixin.mkdir when create_parents=True
SFTPEnumerateMixin — StorageEnumerateProtocol: exact-path enumeration that does not follow discovered directory links (not in sftp __all__)
SFTPDirectoryMixin — StorageDirectoryProtocol: list_dir, race-tolerant mkdir with parents, empty-only rmdir
SFTPMetadataMixin — StorageMetadataProtocol: stat-based metadata, path_exists, get_size
key_functions: _helpers._remote_path(profile, path) -> str — converts sftp://HOST[:PORT]/p to /p; rejects host/port mismatch, explicit port 0, query or fragment with LocationNotAllowed
_helpers._wrap_sftp_error(exc, path) -> StorageError | None — ENOENT/EACCES/paramiko auth and SSH errors to typed errors
_helpers._check_not_directory(client, path) — recovers ENOTDIR when SFTP v3 reports NO_SUCH_FILE
_helpers._require_file_type(mode, path) -> int — raises StorageError when the server omits file type
extension_points: Mixins rely on self._get_client() and self.storage_profile; SFTPWriteMixin additionally requires self.mkdir, so it cannot be composed without SFTPDirectoryMixin.
lifecycle_notes: Borrowed client: the backend never opens or closes the SSH/SFTP session; StorageFacade owns the SFTPConnection (SSHConnection decorator).
paramiko is imported lazily inside _wrap_sftp_error; using the backend needs the [sftp] extra.
open_ranged keeps one remote file handle open until the RangedSource is closed; callers must close random streams before the facade.
documentation_hooks: Support matrix row: SFTP = Read, Write, Enumerate, Delete, Metadata, Directory, RangedRead; no Copy (copy_between streams through).
sftp:// URL handling and host/port confinement against the profile (security note).
Directory semantics: mkdir parent creation across SFTP v3 ambiguities; rmdir empty-only.
Enumeration and symlink handling on SFTP; UTC-aware timestamps.
risks: SFTPWriteMixin.write_from_stream calls stream.read() and buffers the whole payload in memory, unlike S3/local streaming writes; this also applies to copy_between and pipeline writes targeting SFTP.
No StorageCopyProtocol: same-server copies download and re-upload via copy_between.
SFTPStorageBackend docstring says 'Read, Write, List, Delete, Metadata' and omits Enumerate, Directory and RangedRead; AGENTS.md also omits enumerate.
sftp __all__ exports private helpers _is_not_found and _wrap_sftp_error but omits SFTPEnumerateMixin.
open_ranged has no ETag/version pinning; concurrent remote modification is not detected.
open_questions: Should _is_not_found and _wrap_sftp_error remain in sftp __all__ (underscore names) or be dropped, and should SFTPEnumerateMixin be added?
No examples/ recipe exercises SFTP; is one planned?

evidence.detail: @register_storage_backend(SFTP) class SFTPStorageBackend(SFTPReadMixin, SFTPWriteMixin, SFTPDeleteMixin, SFTPMetadataMixin, SFTPDirectoryMixin, SFTPEnumerateMixin); __all__ includes _is_not_found/_wrap_sftp_error.
open_ranged returns RangedSource(size, fetch, close) over a native handle.
_remote_path enforces host/port match with profile HOST/PORT.
Port-0 rejection 2026-10-29, sftp:// URL handling 2026-10-28, enumeration 2026-10-17; evolving.
